name: Eastern & Oriental Berhad
summary: Eastern & Oriental Berhad functions as an investment holding company, with its core business revolving around the investment, development, and comprehensive management of residential and commercial real estate throughout Malaysia. The company segments its diverse operations into three principal areas: Properties, Hospitality, and Investments & Others. Beyond its property development and ownership activities, the firm is also deeply involved in the hospitality sector, overseeing the management and operation of hotels, serviced apartments, and various dining establishments. Its service offerings extend to general management, the leasing and operation of serviced accommodations, and the provision of related hospitality services. Further undertakings include housing development, land reclamation projects, comprehensive project management, and the sales and marketing efforts for its numerous property development ventures. Eastern & Oriental Berhad, founded in 1885, maintains its corporate headquarters in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
